profile.campus: Aligned Northern Virginia campus (Ashburn/Data Center Alley)

source.basis: Operator location page, structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

profile.reading: Aligned Ashburn IAD-01 sits at 21890 Uunet Drive in Ashburn, Virginia, the first building on Aligned Data Centers 26-acre Northern Virginia campus in Data Center Alley, the world densest concentration of colocation and cloud infrastructure. Per the operator own June 2020 press release covering the campus second building, IAD-01, known internally as Phase 1, delivered 60 megawatts of critical capacity across 370,000 square feet and was completed in 2019 in roughly six and a half months, a build speed Aligned has repeatedly cited as a competitive differentiator. The facility was built to a Tier III design standard. Aligned itself, formerly known as Aligned Energy, describes itself today as operating more than fifty campuses and roughly five gigawatts of contracted and available capacity across the Americas, with its Latin American operations run under the ODATA brand. Ownership has shifted substantially over the company history. Macquarie Infrastructure Partners first invested in April 2018 alongside existing investor BlueMountain Capital Management, Mubadala Investment Company took a minority stake in August 2023 with Macquarie Asset Management confirmed as majority partner, CenterSquare Investment Management invested in April 2024, and Macquarie led a more than 12 billion dollar capital raise in January 2025. In October 2025 Aligned announced that a consortium called AI Infrastructure Partnership, combining BlackRock Global Infrastructure Partners and MGX, agreed to acquire all of Aligned equity from Macquarie and its co-investors in a deal valued near 40 billion dollars, with the company own materials indicating a close around July 2026, though a dedicated closing press release could not be independently verified this session. No specific tenant is named for IAD-01 in any source reviewed, consistent with Aligned general practice of not disclosing individual hyperscale or enterprise customers by name.
profile.research_note: 60 MW / 370,000 sqft / 2019 completion sourced to Aligned own June 2020 PR describing IAD-01 as Phase 1 of the Ashburn campus. Ownership history and pending AIP/GIP/MGX acquisition sourced to Aligned own press releases, the July 2026 close date is sourced only to Aligned llms.txt summary file, not a discrete PR, flagged as such. No tenant named.

reading.body:
Aligned IAD-01 is a Tier III designed facility on a 26-acre site in Ashburn, a major data center hub in Northern Virginia. The operator publishes no IT capacity or power figure for this building, so its scale relative to the region cannot be read from disclosed specifications.

Virginia hosts 326 mapped data center facilities, but only 23 operators publish power capacity figures totaling 1,375 MW. This campus does not appear in that published set, placing it below the threshold of disclosed megawatt capacity in a state where one facility would rank 24th among those that do publish.

Aligned operates 50 campuses with over 5 GW of stated capacity across the United States and Latin America. Without a power or rack figure for IAD-01 itself, this facility's contribution to that portfolio and its significance for AI infrastructure scaling cannot be determined from available public data.
